summary_1line: After Jarasandha’s death, Sahadeva is crowned king of Magadha; Krishna departs, and the Pandavas launch campaigns to collect tribute for Yudhishthira’s rule.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna installs Sahadeva, son of Jarasandha, on the throne of Magadha as princes and priests stand around with heaps of jewels.
The Pandavas walk ceremonially around Krishna’s celestial chariot as he prepares to depart from Indraprastha.
Arjuna sets out northward in a radiant celestial chariot with a vast army following behind his banner.
